0022600020.text: The Heat (0-4, 15th in the East) host the Pacers (2-2, 8th in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, with Miami on a four-game losing streak and 0-3 at home. Miami is without Simone Fontecchio (illness), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet this season, and Miami lost the 2025-26 series 1-2, including a 135-118 defeat in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
